claim: For every finite binary stage n, the complex-linear map diagonalCylinderL2 sends a diagonal observable to the L2 equivalence class of its Cantor cylinder function and preserves the finite Bernoulli inner product: the L2 inner product of the images of f and g equals DiagTrace n (fun w => star (f w) * g w).

carrier.type: DiagAlg n := (Fin n → Bool) → ℂ; Boundary := ℕ → Bool; L2Boundary := Lp ℂ 2 fractalMeasure
operations: cylinder n f x := f (boundaryPrefix n x)
DiagTrace n h := (2 : ℂ)⁻¹ ^ n * ∑ w : Fin n → Bool, h w
The target inner product is the Mathlib complex L2 inner product, conjugate-linear in the first argument.
conventions: fractalMeasure is the countable product of fair Boolean probability measures.
Each length-n cylinder has measure (1 / 2 : ℝ≥0∞)^n.
The finite quadratic form cylinderKMSQuadratic n f is 2⁻ⁿ times the sum of squared pointwise norms over BitWord n.

consumers: The existing finite PiLp realization of cylinderKMSQuadratic is to be matched with the same finite stage represented inside the concrete Cantor-boundary L2 space.
The result is a stagewise diagonal embedding only; it does not identify the full finite-matrix GNS stages or their filtered colimit with all of L2Boundary.

smallest_gap.description: Construct the stagewise complex-linear map by sending f to the L2 class of the existing cylinder n f, and prove its inner-product identity using the fair product measure and finite-prefix trace formula.

out_of_scope: No density or closure theorem for the union of finite cylinder stages in L2Boundary.
No identification of the full finite-matrix GNS stages or filtered GNS colimit with L2Boundary.
No completion or representation theorem for the universal Cuntz C-star algebra.
No KMS theorem for the concrete spatial vector state.
